title: Add clap version attributes to Cli struct
description:
Add the version attribute to the Cli struct in src/cli/mod.rs using clap's derive API.

- Add `#[command(propagate_version = true)]` to ensure subcommands inherit version
- Verify the attributes are correctly placed on the Cli struct definition

title: Investigate current --version flag behavior

title: Test bead dependencies and close
description:
Acceptance Criteria:
- Create two test beads: bead-a and bead-b
- Use 'bf dep add blocker bead-b --blocks bead-a' to create dependency
- Verify with 'bf show bead-a' that bead-b is listed as a blocker
- Use 'bf close bead-b --reason "Test close"' to close bead-b
- Verify bead-b status is 'done'
- Verify bead-a is no longer blocked
- Clean up: close bead-a after verification

This tests dependency management and bead closing functionality.

title: Test bead reopen operation
description:

- Reopen the bead with 'bf reopen <id>'
- Verify bead status changes from 'done' back to 'in_progress' with 'bf show <id>'
- Verify the bead is actionable again
